name: Bloom & Root Nursery
tagline: Houseplants, patio plants and garden advice in Seattle
home: Bloom & Root is a neighborhood plant nursery in Ballard, Seattle. We sell houseplants, herbs, vegetable starts, pots and organic soil.
Every plant comes with a care card that tells you how much light and water it needs. We deliver across Seattle.
about: We grow most of our vegetable starts ourselves in the greenhouse behind the shop.
We don't sell chemical fertilizers; our compost is made on site.

posts.title: Growing basil on a balcony
posts.description: How to keep balcony basil bushy and green all summer.
posts.body:
Basil needs at least six hours of direct sun. A south- or west-facing balcony is ideal.

## Pot and soil

Use an eight-inch pot with drainage and a light potting mix with compost.

## Watering

Water when the top inch of soil is dry. Wet roots rot.

## Pinch the flowers

Pinch off flower buds as soon as they appear so the plant keeps making leaves.

posts.title: Watering plants in a heatwave
posts.description: Keep potted plants alive when temperatures spike.
posts.body:
The most common mistake in a heatwave is watering at midday, when water evaporates before it reaches the roots.

## Water early

Water in the first two hours after sunrise.

## Mulch

A layer of bark or straw on top of the soil keeps moisture in.

## Check with a finger

Push a finger an inch into the soil. Water only if it's dry there too.
